hosting.//ignore: Explicit ignorelist, never a dotfile blanket. The previous "**/.*" excluded every dot path and .well-known is a dot DIRECTORY, so apple-app-site-association + assetlinks.json were one deploy path away from being dropped (App/Universal links then verify against nothing). No "!" negation either: firebase-tools forwards hosting.ignore straight to glob's ignore option, where "!" does not re-include. Verify with: node scripts/validate-mobile-hosting.cjs

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://checkout.razorpay.com https://*.razorpay.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.razorpay.com https://*.razorpay.com https://*.googleapis.com https://*.gstatic.com https://*.firebaseio.com wss://*.firebaseio.com https://*.cloudfunctions.net; frame-src https://checkout.razorpay.com https://*.razorpay.com https://api.razorpay.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

headers.//: JSON MIME for the association files. apple-app-site-association has no extension, so without this the catch-all X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff above applies to a non-JSON response type and iOS rejects it. Placed after the "**" rule so it deterministically wins for these two paths. Mirrors public/_headers + netlify.toml.
